title: The Cold War
summary: After World War II the United States and its allies and the Soviet Union and its satellite states entered a decades-long struggle for supremacy without direct battle between their soldiers. The Truman Doctrine of 1947 marked a turn in US policy; the Soviet Union's collapse in December 1991 ended the bipolar contest.

uncertainty.note: Sources date the origins to 1945-1946 tensions; 1947 is the Truman Doctrine marker. The end is dated by the USSR's dissolution; the Office of the Historian also links the Cold War's end to the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989.
